title: Ổn định giao diện tạo mẫu bàn trên mobile
rootCause: CustomTableBuilderResponsiveFix.css is loaded globally while Table3DSimulatorModal.scss can be injected later with the route feature. Their mobile selectors had equal specificity, so the later one-column builder rules could override the intended compact phone layout. The smallest correct fix is to anchor the repair selectors to both .modal-container.custom-table-builder-modal and .custom-table-builder so the scoped repair wins regardless of stylesheet insertion order.
